meta.title: Frankencoin for treasuries: companies, funds and DAOs
meta.description: Hold part of your treasury in on-chain Swiss francs and earn the protocol rate. Multisig-ready, accounting reports, public legal opinions.

hero.title: Diversify your treasury into Swiss francs.
hero.subtitle: Companies, funds and DAOs keep most on-chain reserves in US dollars. ZCHF adds the franc, earns the protocol rate, and never depends on an issuer's bank.

items.title: Currency diversification
items.description: Hold the franc next to USD stablecoins without leaving the chain.

items.title: Yield on idle reserves
items.description: The savings module pays the protocol rate. The Savings Vault (svZCHF) gives you the same as one tradable token.

items.title: No issuer, no bank
items.description: No company can freeze or redeem your balance. Backing is over-collateralised and visible on-chain.

items.title: Governance voice
items.description: Holding FCS gives you a say in which collateral the system accepts, and a share of its income.

items.title: Multisig ready
items.description: Works from a Safe multisig. The app runs inside Safe's interface.

items.title: Accounting reports
items.description: Yearly reports of interest and FCS holdings per address, ready for your accountant.

items.title: Institutional custody
items.description: Supported by institutional custodians in the ecosystem.

items.title: Legal opinions
items.description: Public Swiss and EU (MiCA) legal opinions on how ZCHF is classified.

dao.title: For DAOs
dao.subtitle: Most DAO treasuries sit in their own token and US dollars. A ZCHF allocation in savings earns the protocol rate in a second currency. Adding FCS gives the DAO a vote on new collateral and a share of protocol income, alongside the price risk that comes with equity.

cta.title: Planning an allocation?
cta.body: The Frankencoin Association can walk your team through custody, accounting and liquidity for larger amounts.
